_source: CBP ruling N345976 (11 Mar 2025): two vent-free gas heater models assembled in Vietnam from a Chinese front panel assembly, burner assembly, oxygen depletion sensor assemblies, ignitor module, thermostatic gas valve, tubes and back panel, with a gas selector valve and regulators made in Vietnam: CBP held China. In the D660 selection pool (substantial transformation, dated before 2026, in no development, held-out or tune-check split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.

product.name: Vent-free gas heater
product.description: A wall-mounted infrared or blue-flame gas heater for propane or natural gas with an oxygen depletion sensor.

components.name: oxygen depletion sensor assemblies and ignitor module
front and back panel assemblies and wall bracket
thermostatic gas valve and aluminium tubes

operations.name: cut, punch, bend and paint, then assemble, tighten and test the heater
